entities.name: Şerif Mehmed Rauf Paşa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmed Sherif Rauf Pasha was an Ottoman senator and liberal politician during the Second Constitutional Era, who was a member of the Freedom and Accord Party. A fluent French speaker and strident reformer, he participated in writing the constitution of the Ottoman Empire in 1876 and was a close supporter of fellow reformist Midhat Pasha.

entities.name: Şerif Mehmed Rauf Paşa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmed Sherif Rauf Pasha was an Ottoman senator and liberal politician during the Second Constitutional Era, who was a member of the Freedom and Accord Party. A fluent French speaker and strident reformer, he participated in writing the constitution of the Ottoman Empire in 1876 and was a close supporter of fellow reformist Midhat Pasha.
